verses.original: וַיָּ֣חֶל שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לִבְנ֤וֹת אֶת־ בֵּית־ יְהוָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּהַר֙ הַמּ֣וֹרִיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִרְאָ֖ה לְדָוִ֣יד אָבִ֑יהוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵכִין֙ בִּמְק֣וֹם דָּוִ֔יד בְּגֹ֖רֶן אָרְנָ֥ן הַיְבוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḥel šə·lō·mōh liḇ·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- bêṯ- Yah·weh bî·rū·šā·lim bə·har ham·mō·w·rî·yāh ’ă·šer nir·’āh lə·ḏā·wîḏ ’ā·ḇî·hū ’ă·šer hê·ḵîn bim·qō·wm dā·wîḏ bə·ḡō·ren ’ā·rə·nān hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah where the LORD had appeared to his father David This was the place that David had prepared on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite
verses.literalPt: E COMEÇOU Salomão a edificar a casa do SENHOR em Jerusalém, no monte Moriá, onde o SENHOR aparecera a Davi seu pai, no lugar que Davi tinha preparado na eira de Ornã, o jebuseu.

verses.original: וַ֠יָּחֶל לִבְנ֞וֹת בַּחֹ֤דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי֙ בַּשֵּׁנִ֔י בִּשְׁנַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֖ע לְמַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḥel liḇ·nō·wṯ ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî baš·šê·nî biš·naṯ ’ar·ba‘ lə·mal·ḵū·ṯōw
verses.literal: Solomon began construction on the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign
verses.literalPt: E começou a edificar no segundo mês, no segundo dia, no ano quarto do seu reinado.

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הוּסַ֣ד שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לִבְנ֖וֹת אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים הָאֹ֡רֶךְ אַמּ֞וֹת בַּמִּדָּ֤ה הָרִֽאשׁוֹנָה֙ אַמּ֣וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֔ים וְרֹ֖חַב אַמּ֥וֹת עֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh hū·saḏ šə·lō·mōh liḇ·nō·wṯ ’eṯ- bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hā·’ō·reḵ ’am·mō·wṯ bam·mid·dāh hā·ri·šō·w·nāh ’am·mō·wṯ šiš·šîm wə·rō·ḥaḇ ’am·mō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm
verses.literal: The foundation that Solomon laid for the house of God was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide according to the old standard
verses.literalPt: E estes foram os fundamentos que Salomão pôs para edificar a casa de Deus: o comprimento em côvados, segundo a primeira medida, era de sessenta côvados, e a largura de vinte côvados.

verses.original: וְהָאוּלָ֡ם אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־ פְּנֵ֨י הָאֹ֜רֶךְ עַל־ פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב־ הַבַּ֙יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְהַגֹּ֖בַהּ מֵאָ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַיְצַפֵּ֥הוּ מִפְּנִ֖ימָה זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ū·lām ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ō·reḵ ‘al- pə·nê rō·ḥaḇ- hab·ba·yiṯ ’am·mō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm wə·hag·gō·ḇah mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm way·ṣap·pê·hū mip·pə·nî·māh zā·hāḇ ṭā·hō·wr
verses.literal: The portico at the front . . . extending across . . . the width of the temple was twenty cubits long and twenty cubits high He overlaid the inside with pure gold
verses.literalPt: E o pátio, que estava na frente, tinha vinte côvados de comprimento, segundo a largura da casa, e a altura era de cento e vinte; e por dentro o revestiu com ouro puro.

verses.original: וְאֵ֣ת׀ הַבַּ֣יִת הַגָּד֗וֹל חִפָּה֙ עֵ֣ץ בְּרוֹשִׁ֔ים וַיְחַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָ֣ב ט֑וֹב וַיַּ֧עַל עָלָ֛יו תִּמֹרִ֖ים וְשַׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ hab·ba·yiṯ hag·gā·ḏō·wl ḥip·pāh ‘êṣ bə·rō·wō·šîm way·ḥap·pê·hū zā·hāḇ ṭō·wḇ way·ya·‘al ‘ā·lāw ti·mō·rîm wə·šar·šə·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: He paneled the main room with cypress which he overlaid with fine gold and decorated . . . with palm trees and chains
verses.literalPt: E a casa grande forrou com madeira de faia; e então a revestiu com ouro fino; e fez sobre ela palmas e cadeias.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֧ף אֶת־ הַבַּ֛יִת אֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָ֖ה לְתִפְאָ֑רֶת וְהַזָּהָ֖ב זְהַ֥ב פַּרְוָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣap̄ ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ ’e·ḇen yə·qā·rāh lə·ṯip̄·’ā·reṯ wə·haz·zā·hāḇ zə·haḇ par·wā·yim
verses.literal: He adorned the temple with precious stones for beauty and its gold was from Parvaim
verses.literalPt: Também a casa adornou de pedras preciosas, para ornamento; e o ouro era ouro de Parvaim.

verses.original: וַיְחַ֨ף אֶת־ הַבַּ֜יִת הַקֹּר֧וֹת הַסִּפִּ֛ים וְקִֽירוֹתָ֥יו וְדַלְתוֹתָ֖יו זָהָ֑ב וּפִתַּ֥ח כְּרוּבִ֖ים עַל־ הַקִּירֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḥap̄ ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ haq·qō·rō·wṯ has·sip·pîm wə·qî·rō·w·ṯāw wə·ḏal·ṯō·w·ṯāw zā·hāḇ ū·p̄it·taḥ kə·rū·ḇîm ‘al- haq·qî·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: He overlaid its beams thresholds walls and doors with gold and he carved cherubim on the walls
verses.literalPt: Também na casa revestiu, com ouro, as traves, os umbrais, as suas paredes e as suas portas; e lavrou querubins nas paredes.

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ אֶת־ בֵּֽית־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֔ים אָרְכּ֞וֹ עַל־ פְּנֵ֤י רֹֽחַב־ הַבַּ֙יִת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְרָחְבּ֖וֹ אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וַיְחַפֵּ֙הוּ֙ זָהָ֣ב ט֔וֹב לְכִכָּרִ֖ים שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- bêṯ- qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm ’ā·rə·kōw ‘al- pə·nê rō·ḥaḇ- hab·ba·yiṯ ’am·mō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm wə·rā·ḥə·bōw ’am·mō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm way·ḥap·pê·hū zā·hāḇ ṭō·wḇ lə·ḵik·kā·rîm šêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then he made the Most Holy . . . Place its length corresponded to . . . the width of the temple twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide And he overlaid the inside with six hundred talents of fine gold
verses.literalPt: Fez mais a casa do lugar santíssimo, cujo comprimento, segundo a largura da casa, era de vinte côvados, e também a largura de vinte côvados; e revestiu-a de ouro fino, do peso de seiscentos talentos.

verses.original: וּמִשְׁקָ֛ל לְמִסְמְר֥וֹת לִשְׁקָלִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים זָהָ֑ב וְהָעֲלִיּ֖וֹת חִפָּ֥ה זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miš·qāl lə·mis·mə·rō·wṯ liš·qā·lîm ḥă·miš·šîm zā·hāḇ wə·hā·‘ă·lî·yō·wṯ ḥip·pāh zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold He also overlaid the upper rooms with gold
verses.literalPt: O peso dos pregos era de cinqüenta siclos de ouro; e as câmaras cobriu de ouro.

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ בְּבֵֽית־ קֹ֤דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה צַעֲצֻעִ֑ים וַיְצַפּ֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś bə·ḇêṯ- qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm kə·rū·ḇîm šə·na·yim ma·‘ă·śêh ṣa·‘ă·ṣu·‘îm way·ṣap·pū ’ō·ṯām zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: In the Most Holy . . . Place he made two cherubim of sculptured work and he overlaid them with gold
verses.literalPt: Também fez na casa do lugar santíssimo dois querubins de obra móvel, e cobriu-os de ouro.

verses.original: וְכַנְפֵי֙ הַכְּרוּבִ֔ים אָרְכָּ֖ם אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים כְּנַ֨ף הָאֶחָ֜ד לְאַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֗שׁ מַגַּ֙עַת֙ לְקִ֣יר הַבַּ֔יִת וְהַכָּנָ֤ף הָאַחֶ֙רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֕יעַ לִכְנַ֖ף הַכְּר֥וּב הָאַחֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵan·p̄ê hak·kə·rū·ḇîm ’ā·rə·kām ’am·mō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm kə·nap̄ hā·’e·ḥāḏ lə·’am·mō·wṯ ḥā·mêš mag·ga·‘aṯ lə·qîr hab·ba·yiṯ wə·hak·kā·nāp̄ hā·’a·ḥe·reṯ ’am·mō·wṯ ḥā·mêš mag·gî·a‘ liḵ·nap̄ hak·kə·rūḇ hā·’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: The total wingspan of the cherubim was twenty cubits One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long and touched the wall of the temple and its other wing was five cubits long and touched the wing of the other cherub
verses.literalPt: E, quanto às asas dos querubins, o seu comprimento era de vinte côvados; a asa de um deles, de cinco côvados, e tocava na parede da casa; e a outra asa de cinco côvados, e tocava na asa do outro querubim.

verses.original: וּכְנַ֨ף הַכְּר֤וּב הָאֶחָד֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ מַגִּ֖יעַ לְקִ֣יר הַבָּ֑יִת וְהַכָּנָ֤ף הָאַחֶ֙רֶת֙ אַמּ֣וֹת חָמֵ֔שׁ דְּבֵקָ֕ה לִכְנַ֖ף הַכְּר֥וּב הָאַחֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·nap̄ hak·kə·rūḇ hā·’e·ḥāḏ ’am·mō·wṯ ḥā·mêš mag·gî·a‘ lə·qîr hab·bā·yiṯ wə·hak·kā·nāp̄ hā·’a·ḥe·reṯ ’am·mō·wṯ ḥā·mêš də·ḇê·qāh liḵ·nap̄ hak·kə·rūḇ hā·’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: The wing of the second cherub also measured five cubits and touched the wall of the temple while its other wing measured five cubits and touched the wing of the first cherub
verses.literalPt: Também a asa do outro querubim era de cinco côvados, e tocava na parede da casa; era também a outra asa de cinco côvados, que tocava na asa do outro querubim.

verses.original: כַּנְפֵי֙ הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה פֹּֽרְשִׂ֖ים אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וְהֵ֛ם עֹמְדִ֥ים עַל־ רַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם וּפְנֵיהֶ֥ם לַבָּֽיִת׃ס
verses.transliteration: kan·p̄ê hak·kə·rū·ḇîm hā·’êl·leh pō·rə·śîm ’am·mō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm wə·hêm ‘ō·mə·ḏîm ‘al- raḡ·lê·hem ū·p̄ə·nê·hem lab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: So the total wingspan . . . of these cherubim was twenty cubits They stood on their feet facing the main room
verses.literalPt: E as asas destes querubins se estendiam vinte côvados; e estavam postos em pé, e os seus rostos virados para a casa.

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ אֶת־ הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְכַרְמִ֣יל וּב֑וּץ וַיַּ֥עַל עָלָ֖יו כְּרוּבִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- hap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ḵar·mîl ū·ḇūṣ way·ya·‘al ‘ā·lāw kə·rū·ḇîm
verses.literal: He made the veil of blue purple and crimson yarn and fine linen with cherubim woven into it
verses.literalPt: Também fez o véu de azul, púrpura, carmesim e linho fino; e pôs sobre ele querubins;

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לִפְנֵ֤י הַבַּ֙יִת֙ עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם אַמּ֕וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ אֹ֑רֶךְ וְהַצֶּ֥פֶת אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ רֹאשׁ֖וֹ אַמּ֥וֹת חָמֵֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś lip̄·nê hab·ba·yiṯ ‘am·mū·ḏîm šə·na·yim ’am·mō·wṯ šə·lō·šîm wə·ḥā·mêš ’ō·reḵ wə·haṣ·ṣe·p̄eṯ ’ă·šer- ‘al- rō·šōw ’am·mō·wṯ ḥā·mêš
verses.literal: In front of the temple he made two pillars which together were thirty-five . . . cubits high each with a capital on top measuring five cubits
verses.literalPt: Fez também, diante da casa, duas colunas de trinta e cinco côvados de altura; e o capitel, que estava sobre cada uma, era de cinco côvados.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ שַׁרְשְׁרוֹת֙ בַּדְּבִ֔יר וַיִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָעַמֻּדִ֑ים וַיַּ֤עַשׂ רִמּוֹנִים֙ מֵאָ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֖ן בַּֽשַּׁרְשְׁרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś šar·šə·rō·wṯ bad·də·ḇîr way·yit·tên ‘al- rōš hā·‘am·mu·ḏîm way·ya·‘aś rim·mō·w·nîm mê·’āh way·yit·tên baš·šar·šə·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: He made interwoven chains and put them on top of the pillars He made a hundred pomegranates and fastened them into the chainwork
verses.literalPt: Também fez cadeias no oráculo, e as pôs sobre as cabeças das colunas; fez também cem romãs, as quais pôs entre as cadeias.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קֶם אֶת־ הָֽעַמּוּדִים֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַהֵיכָ֔ל אֶחָ֥ד מִיָּמִ֖ין וְאֶחָ֣ד מֵֽהַשְּׂמֹ֑אול וַיִּקְרָ֤א שֵׁם־ הַיְמִינִי יָכִ֔ין וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשְּׂמָאלִ֖י בֹּֽעַז׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem ’eṯ- hā·‘am·mū·ḏîm ‘al- pə·nê ha·hê·ḵāl ’e·ḥāḏ mî·yā·mîn wə·’e·ḥāḏ mê·haś·śə·mō·wl way·yiq·rā šêm- hay·mī·nī yā·ḵîn wə·šêm haś·śə·mā·lî bō·‘az
verses.literal: Then he set up the pillars in front of the temple one on the south and one on the north The pillar on the south he named . . . Jachin and the pillar on the north he named Boaz
verses.literalPt: E levantou as colunas diante do templo, uma à direita, e outra à esquerda; e chamou o nome da que estava à direita Jaquim, e o nome da que estava à esquerda Boaz.
